artworks.title: Thomas Egerton, First Viscount of Brackley
artworks.description: The image is an oval portrait engraving of a man named Thomas Egerton. He is depicted seated, facing slightly to his right but looking at the viewer. He has a high forehead, a short beard, mustache, and short, combed-back hair. He wears elaborate clothing with a large lace collar, a richly decorated coat with embroidery, and a chain with a pendant. His right hand is visible, holding a document or paper. The background inside the oval is plain with etched lines, while the outside contains ornate scrollwork and Latin text.

artworks.title: Christian, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body. He is looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile, wearing a large hat and period-style outfit. The man has medium-length hair peeking out from under the hat and is holding the hilt of a sword on his right side. The background shows even horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Christian, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving with multiple sections. In the center is the bust of Christiaen Hertoch tot Brunswyck, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and intricate clothing with a high lace collar. Flanking him are two full-length figures holding flags with inscriptions. The background and borders are ornate with scrollwork and combat scenes. The top and bottom sections show vignettes of swordplay and a dramatic scene around a drum, with figures in period clothing.

artworks.title: George Villiers, First Duke of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image depicts an elegantly dressed man from the knees up. He faces slightly to the right, with one hand on his chest and the other holding a staff or baton. His face is turned towards the viewer with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, curly light-colored hair, a high-status outfit with a richly decorated doublet, intricate lace cuffs, a high lace collar, a draped cloak over his left shoulder, and a heavy chain around his neck. The ornate portrait is bordered by an oval frame with decorative elements. The background shows a curtain on the left and a detailed scroll with text, symbols, and figures in the lower half.

artworks.title: George Villiers, First Duke of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man standing in a slightly angled position, facing towards the viewer's right. He has well-defined facial features with a mustache and a beard, and medium-length curly hair. He is wearing an ornate garment with lace cuffs and a detailed pattern, holding a large sash or cloak over one shoulder. The man has one hand resting on a stack of books or pedestal, and is wearing a ruffled collar around his neck. In one hand, he holds what appears to be a jewel or ornate clasp. The background features a tall column, and the portrait is enclosed in a decorative frame with floral and horn motifs, as well as classical figures playing musical instruments at the base. An inscription surrounds the portrait within the frame.

artworks.title: James Hay, First Earl of Carlisle
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, with a high forehead, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, curly hair styled in a manner common for the early 17th century, and wearing a decorated garment, possibly a doublet, with intricate patterns and a lace ruff around his neck. He has a bracelet or cuff on his left wrist, his right hand holds a stick, and his left hand rests on his chest. The frame around the portrait contains text and a coat of arms at the top with two figures and a shield with a cross. The background has a textured shading for depth.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England as Duke of York
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is facing forward with a slight turn to their left side. They have a youthful appearance with smooth facial features, including closely aligned eyes, a small nose, and a closed mouth. Their hair is short and neatly combed back away from their forehead. The individual is wearing elaborate attire that includes a richly adorned garment with a high, intricate lace collar and a sash. There is also a pendant hanging from a chain around their neck. In the background, the portrait is enclosed in an ornate circular design with text surrounding it, and the inside of the circle features a finely textured pattern.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England, as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person. The individual is depicted from the upper body, slightly turned to the right. They have a young face with delicate features, styled hair, and wear a garment with a high lace ruff around the neck. The clothing includes ornate armor. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscription, and a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England, as Duke of York
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait depicting the upper body of a seated individual facing slightly to their left. The person has distinctive facial features with closed lips, a nose, and eyes looking directly at the viewer. They have upward styled hair with slight curls at the sides. The person is wearing an elaborate outfit that includes a detailed ruffled collar, a patterned doublet with vertical decorations, and ornate sleeves. There are no visible accessories or objects. An oval border surrounds the portrait with Latin text, and on either side, there are male and female figures holding staffs. The background is textured, contrasting with the smooth depiction of the person within the circular frame.

artworks.title: Sir Edward Coke
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait from the waist up, facing forward with his body slightly turned to his right. He has a neat beard and mustache, short, combed hair, and is wearing a high-collared garment with detailed designs or embroidery. He holds a small book in his right hand. The background features an ornate oval frame surrounding his bust, with scrollwork and Latin text around and beneath the portrait. Small shelves with books are in the lower corners for additional scholarly elements.

artworks.title: Richard Sackville, Third Earl of Dorset
artworks.description: The image is a portrait depicting a man's upper body. He has a prominent beard, mustache, and curly hair. He is dressed in noble clothing with a lace collar and cuffs. The man's expression is calm, with his head facing the viewer. The background includes an ornate frame with decorative elements.

artworks.title: Richard Sackville, Third Earl of Dorset
artworks.description: The image features a man with a pointed beard and a receding hairline, wearing a dark-colored garment with ornate embroidery and a large lace ruff around his neck. He is positioned slightly to the left, facing the viewer and gently holding onto his garment's lace with his right hand. The portrait is framed with Latin inscriptions, decorative scrollwork, and a coat of arms at the top. The background has a textured pattern that highlights the central figure.

artworks.title: Diego Sarmiento de Acuna, Count of Gondomar
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a man from the chest upwards. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the side. The man has a solemn expression, a high forehead, a prominent nose, and a distinct goatee. He has closely cropped hair and wears a large ruff around his neck. He is dressed formally with a chain and pendant hanging over his chest. The background is dark, with the portrait set in an ornate oval frame. There is Latin text above and around the frame, and additional Latin writing in a decorative panel below the portrait.

artworks.title: Diego Sarmiento de Acuna, Count of Gondomar
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man from the torso up. He is facing slightly to his right with a composed expression. He has a neatly trimmed beard, a receding hairline, short hair blending with his facial hair, and is dressed in a formal garment with a high, ornate ruff around his neck and a dark robe adorned with intricate patterns. There is a visible chain with a large medallion or order. The oval-framed engraving features a Latin inscription. The background is dark and textured, emphasizing the subject. Below the oval, a decorative cartouche dedicates the engraving to Diego Sarmiento de Acuna, the Earl of Gondomar, identified as an ambassador from Spain to Britain. The engraving is set against a plain, light background.

artworks.title: Diego Sarmiento de Acuna, Count of Gondomar
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He has a mature face with a short beard and mustache, his hair is neatly combed back, and he wears a formal, dark-colored garment with a high ruffled collar. A chain with a medallion hangs from his neck. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscriptions and a coat of arms above it. Below the portrait, a decorative text panel provides details about the person depicted. The engraving is highly detailed with fine line work.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Hobart
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man shown from the waist up, seated in a slightly turned position. He gazes directly outwards with a calm expression, his face framed by a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair is partially visible under a modest cap. The man's clothing is ornate and indicative of high status, featuring an elaborate ruffled collar and a richly adorned garment with a draped fabric across his chest. He wears a heavy chain around his shoulders. In his hand, he holds a rolled document. The background is an intricately detailed patterned backdrop framed by a decorative oval containing Latin text, with additional ornate designs and flourishes surrounding his figure. A coat of arms sits at the top of the frame.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Hobart
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is seated in a slightly turned position, his gaze directed towards the viewer. His facial features include a stern expression, a high forehead, and a trimmed beard and mustache. His hair is short and covered with a dark cap. The man is dressed in elaborate clothing, featuring a large, ruffled white collar and a robe adorned with intricate embroidery and patterned accents. Draped across his chest is a chain with ornate links and a large clasp. In his hand, he holds a scroll or a rolled-up piece of parchment. The background consists of an ornate oval frame with decorative elements and Latin inscriptions surrounding the portrait, indicating the man's noble or official status. The bottom of the image includes an inscription describing his titles and achievements.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Hobart
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man shown from the waist up within an ornate oval frame. He is seated in a formal, upright position with his body slightly turned to the left and his gaze directed toward the viewer. The man has distinct facial features; a prominent nose, bushy eyebrows, and a short, well-groomed beard. His hair is mostly covered by a cap, with some curls visible at the sides. He is dressed in a richly detailed outfit, featuring a prominent ruff collar and a robe with intricately designed trim. A chain of office is draped around his shoulders. In his hands, he holds an unidentified object. The background consists of an elaborate decorative border, featuring scrollwork and an inscription on a banner surrounding the frame with text.

artworks.title: James I of England
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated on a throne. The man faces forward with his body slightly turned to the right. He has a pointed beard and mustache, neat hair, and wears a crown. He is draped in ornate robes with a high lace ruff collar and wide sleeves. He wears a chain with a medallion and holds a scepter in his right hand while his left hand rests on an orb. The throne has ornate lion heads on the armrests. The background features tapestries, framed walls, and a canopy. An inscription below the throne adds to the scene.

artworks.title: James I of England
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a throne. The individual is facing forward, with both hands resting on their lap. One hand holds a large orb topped with a cross. The person has a full, neatly trimmed beard and moustache, and short hair. They wear a crown on their head and regal attire. The clothing is detailed, featuring a fur-lined mantle with patterns and a high collar. A chain with a large medallion is worn around their neck. The background includes windows with patterned glass, and the throne has lion heads on the armrests. There is a decorative tapestry on the rear wall.

artworks.title: John King, Bishop of London
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man visible from the waist up. The man is seated with his body facing slightly to the left, his gaze directed straight ahead. He has a long, narrow face with a prominent nose, a full, long beard and mustache, and high, furrowed eyebrows. His hair is cut relatively short and covered with a closely-fitted cap. The man is dressed in formal attire typical of the time, featuring a high, stiff ruff around his neck and a dark robe worn over a voluminous white shirt with puffed sleeves. His hands are holding an open book, which is resting on a cloth in front of him. Surrounding the portrait is an ornate architectural border with scrollwork, including an emblem featuring a bishop’s mitre. Text in Latin is inscribed around the border and at the bottom of the image. The background is a simple, darkly hatched area, highlighting the subject.

artworks.title: John King, Bishop of London
artworks.description: The image shows a monochromatic portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated and facing directly towards the viewer with his hands resting on an open book on a surface before him. The man has a long, full beard and mustache, and his hair is covered by a cap. He wears a formal robe with a white ruffled collar and puffy sleeves, typical of historical clergy attire. The background features an ornate border with ribbons and a coat of arms at the top center. Surrounding the man's portrait are scrolling inscriptions and text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Robert Sidney, First Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a gentleman sitting in a formal posture. The man has sharp facial features, a mustache, a small pointed beard, wavy medium-length hair styled away from his face, and is wearing a richly adorned outfit with a large lace ruff around his neck and a fur-lined cape on his shoulders. He is holding a piece of parchment or paper in his right hand and wearing a medallion on a ribbon around his neck. The background has ornate swirls and heraldic elements, a coat of arms above his head, and decorative script around the portrait. The image has detailed linework and shading, creating a classic and historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Robert Sidney, First Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait engraving of a man. The man is shown from the waist up, positioned slightly angled to the left and looking straight ahead. He has a beard and mustache, styled hair with curls around his temples and forehead, and is wearing elaborate Elizabethan attire, including a robe with a fur collar and a ruffled lace collar. The clothing has fine patterns, and the background includes decorative elements like ribbons and a crest. There is Latin text above and below the portrait in elegant calligraphy.
